questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Four different remaining rank8 identities retain eight placements. Prismatic Wall alone has four unassigned rank9 placements; class grants remain Abjuration8. The three others keep their own current Divination/Universal grants.
options: Preserve every placement and actual access row; decide each identity independently.
Grant unassigned schools/rank9 access or treat this cohort as one shared planar mechanic.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend independent decisions. Native Action/120ft/V,S,F/21RP remain unless an explicit source conflict is selected. Seven layers, multiple-faction interaction, deity child spell and all three stabilization categories must each remain substantive benefits.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original cosmology and explicit owner corrections preserve public theology versus hidden identity. Later EPI/souls operating records supersede old pending-mechanics navigation within their own scopes, not all lore.
options: Apply exact current mechanics and owner corrections while retaining original source assertions and unresolved identity/epoch seams.
Infer divine identities, guaranteed rescue, realm equivalence or new gameplay laws from evocative names.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the first option. Functioning faith magic does not identify a worship mask with a Choir member or establish a deity’s stat block. No new global cosmic law or whole-game approval.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All five native placements promise seven layers with different/devastating effects; no colors, damage types, amounts, conditions or counters are printed.
options: Author seven complete distinct layer definitions with explicit values, saves, condition/lifecycle and counterplay.
Import another game’s rainbow table or supply only decorative layers/one generic damage wall.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend seven substantive labelled NEW effects, each with exact trigger, amount/type/defense, event identity and counter. Do not silently add death, petrification, planar exile or compulsory movement from an external spell. Their selection and numerical balance are separate gates.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core gives120ft, concentration up to1minute and wall of light but no dimensions, thickness, orientation, panel layout, opacity or support.
options: Define a finite layered wall with explicit geometry, whole-body formation legality and light/line-of-effect properties.
Assume an infinite barrier, supporting platform, arbitrary dome or physical material from the title.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend fixed finite geometry, exact seven-layer order/thickness and formation preflight. Every selected point must obey actual placement rules. Decide physical blocking versus harmful traversability explicitly; no creation damage by silently forming inside a body, free harvested material or guaranteed safety through an undefined interior.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Walking, forced movement, carried creatures, partial bodies and endpoint teleport can meet different layer boundaries. Multiple layer events affect Null snapshots/Wounds and control history.
options: Specify continuous whole-body crossing and ordered layer admission, including direction reversal, stopping and independently transported bodies.
Apply all layers to any nearby target or invent a teleport path between outside endpoints.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend exact trigger/contact semantics and event ordering with current costs, actual movement and independently checked passengers. Decide first-entry/reentry cadence and per-layer roots explicitly; no splitting/combining damage merely to change Wounds. Actual transport endpoints follow the chosen wall rule.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Layer removal may interact with ordinary dispel, Greater Dispel, suppression and any separately authored color counter. The spell has no printed dispel immunity.
options: Give each real removal route a finite source-qualified contract; distinguish layer removal from whole-source ending.
Make the wall absolutely immune or let any thematically matching spell erase any layer without a rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend choose whether counters remove local portions, whole layers or the full wall, with real ranges/costs/rank gates and ordering. No unowned ability or pending spell is a working positive counter. Missing counter content remains a named hold, not a fabricated success.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Exact Wall of Force suppression preserves clipped geometry and delays occupied returning portions; this is a scoped comparison, not an automatic Prismatic rule.
options: Select explicit suppression/resumption, concentration ending, layer state and recast behavior preserving real occupants and clocks.
Rebuild all layers fresh on suppression/recast or resume harmful layers inside bodies without admission rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend no duration or removed-layer refresh, no crush/sever/eject shortcut and deterministic pending occupied portions if jointly selected. Preserve actual damage/control histories and independent existing conditions; layer ending does not undo already resolved events.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: See how actions of multiple factions will interact; Core120ft does not identify targets/references, query breadth or future horizon. Faction Omniscience has its own explicit local-reference/global-institution contract.
options: Select actual known faction identities and a concrete interaction scenario, with an explicit source-faithful120ft reference or expressly reconciled abstract inquiry.
Restrict to one faction, nearby actions only, or invent hidden factions as valid named targets.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserve genuinely multiple institutions and their interacting actions. Define lower/upper selection rules and a finite future horizon without arbitrary sampling that removes the printed benefit. Any local reference gates are NEW; remote institutional consequences need their own stated reach.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Established faction orders/projects, active plans and future voluntary choices are distinct. The source promises interaction insight, not compelled prophecy or mere repetition of public information.
options: Return supported causal interactions and conditional outcomes from actual current plans and world state.
Invent fixed future decisions or reduce the result to current known objectives with no interaction forecast.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an explicit structured interaction report: which actual actions support, obstruct, compete or change each other, with qualified dependencies and selected horizon. Preserve useful unprotected hidden facts; unknown choices stay conditional and cannot be made true merely because the spell predicted them.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Applied Faction Divination/Omniscience preserve independent institutional facts while protecting the actual existence, identity, location or private information fields targeted by real wards.
options: Evaluate each forecast premise/output field using actual generating-rank and subject/site protection scope.
Hide everything whenever one member is protected or reconstruct protected identities from cross-faction differences.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend readable independent causal portions remain; protected/undefined necessities are Indeterminate without diagnostic counts or existence placeholders. Do not flatten all information into Alignment Forecast’s five-result vocabulary; its bounded output is source-specific.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Repeat casts across casters, renamed institutions, changed plans and apparent future branches can otherwise become a random hidden-fact search.
options: Use canonical faction/action history IDs and stable equivalent-query results until material state changes.
Reroll prophecy or rotate undisclosed facts for cosmetic rephrasing or alternate casters.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend finite event snapshots and stable conditional causal reports, no free standing/membership/order changes. Specify what actual changed fact supports a new forecast and what happens if a faction splits/ends; no invented successor identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A machine can track a large interaction graph, but an instantaneous spell does not grant infinite cognition, time, communication or permanent future updates.
options: Retain every in-scope readable interaction in a navigable report with explicit observation/memory/lifetime rules.
Drop inconvenient branches for manual manageability or make the report an autonomous ongoing oracle.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a complete finite engine report and concise player view. Select whether the spell gives a one-time snapshot or a finite feed and label any duration change; reading/communicating/acting still uses real time and abilities.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Rulebook says call a deity to cast a spell of6th level or lower as free action; Core says Tier6 or lower, casting_time1action. Both are preserved.
options: Keep the outer Action and give the invoked child its explicitly free Action cost.
Choose a different explicit activation interpretation and justify the printed conflict.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend outer ordinary rank8 Action/21RP with a source-scoped child spell requiring no second Action, while keeping6th-level/Tier6 evidence and explicitly selecting rank meaning. Do not erase the free child benefit, silently grant an extra full turn or redefine every free action globally.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source permits a deity spell at6 or lower but supplies no deity repertoire, school list, creature stats, spellcasting ability or relationship gate.
options: Author an explicit bounded eligible child catalog and invocation profile with real rank/access/target prerequisites.
Invent an omnipotent deity actor or silently restrict to only the invoker’s already-known spells.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserve the breadth of an invoked child spell through an explicit NEW eligibility/selection contract. Source-only or unreviewed payloads remain visibly held until operative; do not claim a fully usable catalogue by hiding them. Worship names are not automatically combat actors or a Choir identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Free action does not explicitly decide child RP, components, costly materials, frequency, concentration, armor surcharges or ownership of casting statistics.
options: Specify each parent/child cost and owner once, including the exact waiver supplied by this spell.
Treat free action as unlimited free resources or accidentally charge the outer spell’s Action twice.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require exact NEW selection of child RP/components and any lawful substitution, while preserving finite consumables and actual history. Choose child DC/attack/caster level from a defined invocation profile rather than guessed deity stats. No unowned Mirrorsage/Shaman engine or class feature follows from the invocation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual beginning hooks, counters, source commitment, child legality and concentration replacement are ordered transactions. Deity casting is not already the Fate Echo copying contract.
options: Define outer commitment/counter, child commitment/revalidation, interruption and single-use invocation entitlement.
Resolve the child before paying/countering or refund the parent on hidden child failure.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit source-scoped parent/child sequencing and separate generating ranks/source roots. State exactly who maintains child concentration and what real event ends it. No duplicate release after callbacks/save-load, retroactive target selection or ordinary Ready mid-resolution interrupt.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A child can be a copying, casting or extra-action mechanism, creating indirect recursion even if the child rank ceiling excludes rank8 Intervention itself.
options: Define finite invocation lineage and explicit eligibility for mechanisms that produce further casts/actions.
Permit unbounded descendant invocations or ban all ordinary duration spells as an easy substitute.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend reject only specifically identified recursive/self-amplifying mechanisms with exact lineage limits; ordinary eligible children retain full printed benefits, ongoing duration and lawful counters. Explain each exclusion rather than inheriting Fate Echo’s different restrictions wholesale.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Owner allows extremely rare Divine/Abyssal exceptions to otherwise final Hunted Death, not a purchasable routine spell rescue. Successful faith magic does not reveal cosmic genealogy.
options: Keep ordinary invocation effects separate from the exceptional Hunt-intervention gate and actual campaign/owner authority.
Treat a rank8 spell named Divine Intervention as guaranteed resurrection, Hunt cancellation or proof of a particular god’s identity.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend no automatic exceptional rescue, Hunt reset or soul/identity rewrite. If an actual allowed child recovery spell meets ordinary prerequisites, it still obeys the existing Hunt restriction. Any distinct exceptional intervention remains separately evidenced and rare, never invented by a high roll or name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Stabilize an unstable ZONE, SPELL OR PLANAR RIFT. All three categories matter; Healing/Restoration/Planar tags alone do not define them.
options: Create explicit operative instability and stabilization profiles for each of the three categories.
Reduce the spell to closing rifts, ordinary dispelling, creature healing or repairing missing software adapters.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend support all three printed categories with actual world/effect records and eligibility predicates. Decide whether a zone may be physical, magical or both; neither arbitrary environmental change nor every unresolved design document counts as an unstable zone. Complete meaningful positive profiles instead of declaring every category unusable.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Stabilize does not specify restoring a prior state, stopping progression, preventing a collapse, repairing damage or removing the effect. Core duration isInstantaneous.
options: Define per-category concrete stable outcomes preserving the underlying source and surviving identities.
Rewind history, extend an effect indefinitely or erase the target as a generic dispel.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend one atomic source-qualified transition with explicit unchanged and changed fields. A spell retains paid costs, original expiry and actual ownership unless a specifically selected NEW extension says otherwise. A rift’s stabilized state must distinguish safe persistent connection from closure; no free mass/items/HP reconstruction.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No size/rank ceiling, resistance check or lasting patch duration is printed; existing Greater Dispel and antimagic rules do not automatically decide a stabilizer’s power.
options: Select explicit target geometry/capacity, rank/magnitude limits and success/partial/failure outcomes for genuine instability.
Assume unlimited repair or reuse Greater Dispel’s removal check without explaining the different result.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a finite deterministic interface with labelled NEW limits and actual source-specific resistance, preserving the whole120ft targeting promise. Define known impossible preflight versus hidden paid failure without supplying free diagnostics or silently leaving any category without a working case.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A patch can occur during real collapse, a live spell or occupied planar transit. Stabilization, source ending and suppression have distinct event order and custody consequences.
options: Resolve the actual event window and atomic transition; preserve already resolved damage, transit, inventory and clocks.
Use ordinary Ready to rewrite a completed trigger or delete occupants to make the patch succeed.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend exact commitment/counter/revalidation and genuine interrupt-provider boundaries. Specify repeat-patch idempotency, suppression of an ongoing repair if one is authored, later renewed instability and save/load. Never erase prior state history or bypass actual body/ending/transport rules silently.

futureCaseRequirements: At least two complete deterministic cases per identity after decisions, with actual access/resources, source/provider/target identity, geometry, event clocks, RNG and exact final state.

Prismatic Wall: all seven authored layers applied in a fully specified legal crossing; distinct damage/Null/control events, direction reversal and real stopping. Separate suppression/removal/resumption case with occupied clipped volume and original deadline.

Faction Convergence: multiple actual institutions and their concrete planned/current actions, useful complete interaction forecast, materially changed choice and stable repeat. Protected independent fields remain protected without erasing readable institutional consequences.

Divine Intervention Lesser: actual lawful parent and child payload with selected invocation profile, free child Action, exact RP/components/concentration/counter windows and ownership. Separate failure/recursion/Ready case with actual budgets, no duplicated casting and no invented deity stats.

Reality Patch: at least one full positive case for EACH unstable zone, spell and planar-rift category, plus false/hidden eligibility, real ending/suppression/repeat patch and live occupied-event ordering. Do not claim category completion from missing adapters.

Every case uses actual content or explicitly labelled NEW proposed content. No routine Hunt rescue, lore identity merge, arbitrary numerical balance approval or runtime validation follows from reference calculations.

Divine Intervention Lesser preserves6th-level versusTier6 and outerAction versus free child casting. Parent/child ownership, cost, concentration and lineage require explicit source-specific decisions.

Reality Patch explicitly includes unstable zone, spell and planar rift. All three need working positive stabilization profiles; it cannot be silently narrowed to dispel, rift closure, ordinary healing or a software bug fix.

Applied13 spell counterparts and exact accepted-but-unapplied True Seeing are supplied in full. Their individual output/clock/geometry/copy/ending exceptions do not automatically extend to these four spells.

Original cosmology manuscripts, saved website, corrected gods register and explicit later owner corrections remain full sources. The gods companion’s old pending EPI/plane status is historical; current applied companion records govern only their own declared operational scopes.
Control15 successor is fully accepted but unapplied; copied-feat review remains active. Owner reserved implementation. No further source choices or gameplay rules are adopted by this packet.
